subject: code/validate_results_profiles.py evaluate()
note: each defect must be refused by the rule named for it; the envelope-only control exists because NOT satisfying a profile must stay a legal state, or the validator becomes a gate that excludes an honest line

D1_no_boundary_statement.why: a results file with no stated boundary must not pass the envelope
reported: global_status.statement must be a non-empty string

D2_solved_is_a_string_not_a_boolean.why: 'false' is truthy; the solved flag must be typed, not merely present

D3_a_verified_claim_without_its_text.why: an id with no claim renders as an empty claim-box row
reported: verified_claims[0] needs both id and claim

D4_an_empty_non_claim_string.why: a blank non-claim is worse than none: it renders as a silent boundary
reported: every explicit_non_claims entry must be a non-empty string

D5_verified_claims_present_but_empty.why: an empty array must not read as 'claims satisfied'
reported: verified_claims must be a non-empty array

D6_no_researcher.why: a results file with no attributable author fails the envelope

D7_claims_must_not_pass_over_a_broken_en.why: a renderer told 'claims ok' would trust an unidentifiable file
reported: requires results-envelope/1, which is not satisfied

D8_declares_a_profile_it_does_not_satisf.why: an inferred gap is information; a false declaration is a lie

D9_a_pair_pointing_at_a_field_that_is_no.why: a renamed field must break the declaration loudly, not silently

D10_a_pair_pointing_at_something_that_is.why: a boolean denominator renders as a ratio against true
reported: render_pairs[0].against is not a number: counts.planted

D11_a_pair_with_no_stated_reason.why: a pair nobody can review is a rule nobody can challenge
reported: render_pairs[0] needs a why: a pair with no stated reason cannot be reviewed

D12_render_pairs_present_but_empty.why: an empty array must not read as 'pairs declared'
reported: render_pairs must be a non-empty array

D13_a_figure_pointing_at_a_field_that_is.why: a renamed field must break the declaration, not render blank

D14_a_figure_with_no_label.why: a bare number under no heading is not a figure
reported: headline_figures[0] needs a label: a bare number under no heading is not a figure

D15_a_figure_that_is_also_half_of_a_pair.why: offering a paired value standalone is the bare-numerator defect reintroduced by the mechanism meant to prevent it
reported: headline_figures[0] counts.caught is also part of a render pair; showing it alone is the defect the pair prevents

D16_headline_figures_present_but_empty.why: an empty array must not read as 'figures declared'
reported: headline_figures must be a non-empty array

D17_a_range_declared_as_a_number.why: an interval shown through a number renderer is not a figure
reported: headline_figures[0] is declared a number and is not: counts.span

D18_a_number_declared_as_a_range.why: a renderer told to draw two ends will find one and draw neither
reported: headline_figures[0] is declared a range and must resolve to exactly two numbers: counts.runs

D19_an_unknown_kind.why: a renderer must never be asked to guess how to draw something
reported: headline_figures[0] has an unknown kind 'sparkline'; a renderer cannot guess how to draw it

D20_an_ad_hoc_paths_run_must_not_archive.why: an ad-hoc query and the archived measurement are different artifacts
D20_an_ad_hoc_paths_run_must_not_archive.reported: run with --paths: an ad-hoc query over chosen files is not the cross-branch measurement this log records

D21_a_file_not_read_from_a_git_ref_must_.why: the archived log must cite what a consumer cloning this repository receives, never a path on one machine
D21_a_file_not_read_from_a_git_ref_must_.reported: measured files not read from a git ref: ['C:/tmp/scratch/results.v1.json']. The archived log must cite what a consumer cloning this repository receives, never a path on one machine

C1_a_document_meeting_both_profiles.why: the healthy shape must pass, or the drill above proves nothing

C2_line_specific_sections_are_not_police.why: profiles constrain the shared envelope, never a line's own content

C3_this_tree_s_real_published_file.why: the file a renderer will actually read must satisfy all four, or it loses the protection this tree asked for

C6_declaring_pairs_without_figures_is_a_.why: a line may protect its ratios without nominating headlines; the profiles are independent, not a ladder

C4_envelope_only_is_a_valid_state_not_a_.why: a line outside results-claims/1 is a rendering branch, not a defect

C7_a_full_cross_branch_scan_must_archive.why: the guard must not become a refusal that never lets the canonical measurement be written at all
